about: The id each material phase's peak is saved and exported under (Swift effectiveLongitudinalPeakID / effectiveCrossPeakID / effectiveFlcPeakID): none until the phase's peak is chosen, then that peak's id. Each case starts a fresh analyzer (threshold −40, Taps 1) and runs the shared steps of tooling/analyzer-steps (settings, newTap, materialTap, accept, advance). 'expect' per phase (L, C, FLC): null — no id — or 'selected' — the id of that phase's selected peak, which is there. Expected values are Swift's.

cases.note: before any phase finalises, no phase has a peak id
after the L taps, the fL id is the chosen fL peak's
after Accept and the C taps, the fC id is the chosen fC peak's
after the FLC taps, the FLC id is the chosen FLC peak's
